app.name: Nookery
app.short_description: Animal Crossing (GameCube), native, with online towns
app.long_description:
Nookery, the port of the Animal Crossing decompilation, running natively on the Wii from your own disc image on the SD card or a USB drive. Its quality-of-life options (fast text, no Resetti, single-player shop upgrades, dates to 3000), villagers who make friends and gossip, saves as Dolphin-compatible GCI files on the SD card, and online play: host your town in a public or private lobby, or browse and join others', over Wi-Fi or a USB LAN adapter.
Unofficial and open source. Not affiliated with or endorsed by Nintendo. Needs your own NTSC-U Animal Crossing (GAFE01) disc image.
